target.note: Defects are applied to a LOCAL COPY of the public record. Nothing is written to Nora's repo or witness; the subject under test is whether a stranger following the documented verification procedure DETECTS each defect.

design.why: Rosetta's correction (thread b653992c): shared misses only indicate correlated priors if they survive difficulty stratification. A miss on a tier-3 defect is evidence the defect is hard; a miss on tier-1 is evidence about the verifier.
design.scoring: For each plant: does the documented stranger-verification procedure flag it? caught | missed. Predictions are pre-registered below and are part of the digest.

plants.defect: delete the newest pin (seq 4) and repoint latest.json at seq 3, so the head moves backward
plants.because: rows regression against any retained prior observation is the single thing a witness exists to catch
the numbered pin file for the same seq still carries rows 5; two copies of one fact disagree

plants.defect: delete pin 00000002.json, leaving 1,3,4 and latest intact
plants.because: the seq sequence has a hole; detectable only if the verifier checks contiguity rather than just the head

plants.defect: swap the bodies of 00000002.json and 00000003.json so filename order and seq field disagree
plants.because: filename-to-seq agreement is a cheap check, but only if the verifier makes it

plants.defect: latest.json chain replaced with a different 32-hex value; rows unchanged (equal height, divergent fingerprint)
plants.because: the write path 409s this, but a stranger reading only the repo has no second copy of the chain to compare against; catching it requires an external observation (a quoted SHA, an anchor, or a prior clone)

plants.defect: seq 4 next_pin_due_by set EARLIER than seq 3's, while pinned_at still advances
plants.because: nothing in the documented procedure cross-checks a deadline against its predecessor; the deadline is read forward, not audited backward

plants.defect: latest.json cadence_hours 24 -> 8760 and next_pin_due_by extended to match, making a stale namespace read as current
plants.because: the cadence declaration is self-reported per pin; if a pin may declare its own deadline, a forged pin may declare a generous one
